description: The gate for PLANS, designs and specs — run BEFORE any code is written, the cheapest place to catch a bad design. Returns the same binary verdict shape as validate_ai_output, with findings on completeness, feasibility, performance and scalability implications, security risks and missing considerations (e.g. it rejects a plan that polls an API every 100ms per client, with the request-volume math). Read-only: nothing is executed or stored beyond the verdict. Use validate_ai_output for the code that follows.

context.description: Optional constraints the review should weigh, e.g. {"system": "payments API", "scale": "1M users", "constraints": "PostgreSQL only"}.

expected_input_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 (hex) of the exact UTF-8 bytes you intend to submit. A mismatch is refused before any review, proving the gate saw the file you meant.

plan.description: The implementation plan, design or spec to validate, as plain text or markdown — e.g. a numbered migration plan or an architecture sketch.

previous_receipt_id.description: Optional receipt_id of the review this submission revises or adjudicates; recorded to link the review history.

name: validate_plan

confidence.description: Legacy alias of score / 100. NOT a calibrated probability or accuracy.

decision.description: The one final gate decision (see decision_reasons, policy_version).

decision_reasons.description: Every rule that fired; `decisive` marks the ones that set the decision.

failure_class.description: input_error | transient_unavailable | incomplete_review | malformed_review | content_defect | deterministic_veto, or null when approved.

issues.description: Severity-ranked findings, each 'severity|category|detail' with the reasoning

model_opinion.description: The model reviewer's own unmodified verdict/score; may differ from decision.

next_action.description: none | address_conditions | fix_and_resubmit | repair_input | retry_later_or_split | supply_missing_scope_or_split | retry_once_then_escalate | blocked_needs_adjudication

protection.description: Deterministic gate result. A veto here is final — the model review cannot override it.

vetoed.description: True if any veto gate failed the submission

vetoed_by.description: Names of the gates that vetoed, e.g. ['code_reality_gate']

provider.description: Model that ran the deep review, or 'protection-gates-only'

receipt.description: Execution receipt: receipt_id (unique per execution), input_sha256 (SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 input), context_sha256, request_fingerprint (identifies an equivalent request; NOT an approval token), prompt_sha256 and versions, actual provider/model, completion state, elapsed time, scope reviewed/missing, deferred checks and the audit write outcome.

score.description: Blended 0-100 quality telemetry (gates fused with the model score). Not a probability of correctness and not the decision.

valid.description: True ONLY when decision is 'approved' or 'approved_with_conditions'. Rejected, incomplete and refused requests are all false.

title: Gate an implementation plan
